V0.why: Original DiaFuseTrainer, unchanged: reproduces B12 (Setting A).

P0.why: New implementation with default values; must match V0 on dev (implementation check, not a candidate).

V1a.why: Uniform start and softer softmax: delays saturation (collapse is absorbing once alpha->one-hot).

V1b.why: Load balancing 10x stronger: at collapse the original term is worth at most 0.01*ln3=0.011.

V1c.why: Encoder dropout in the gate: every branch keeps receiving classification gradient.

V1d.why: Learned temperature with a 10% uniform floor: no encoder can be switched off entirely.

V1e.why: Noisy gating + per-example entropy penalty (MoE practice).

V2a.why: Static concat path + gated residual: keeps the information of all encoders even if the gate saturates.

V2b.why: Non-linear static fusion (B6-like) on the learned layer mixtures.

V2c.why: Attention over encoder tokens with a query from [mean e; s(x)].

V2d.why: Input-independent learned weighted sum (tests whether input dependence is needed at all).

V3a.head: mlp
V3a.why: B12's decision path is linear end to end (LayerMix, convex mix and W are linear); B6 and B11 have non-linear capacity.

V4a.why: Prototypes: no measurable benefit in the ablations (motivated post hoc; selected on dev only).

V4b.why: Use the prototypes in the decision (average with the head) instead of only as a loss.

V5a.why: Five auxiliary losses at 0.5 each, never tuned; factorial interactions negative.

V5b.why: Consistency on transliteration only (motivated post hoc; selected on dev only).

V5c.why: Original optimisation: constant lr 1e-3, no warmup, no schedule.

V6a.why: B6-style inputs (last layer, default pooling) instead of learned layer mixtures.

V6b.head: mlp
V6b.why: B6 representation + DiaFuse objective: isolates the objective from the backbone.
